name: io.github.ygtalp/rawthink-mcp
title: RAWThink
description: Persistent memory for AI thinking partnerships: hybrid search and a temporal knowledge graph.

environmentVariables.name: RAWTHINK_VAULT
environmentVariables.description: Path to the vault directory holding sessions, qnotes and the knowledge graph.

environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Set to a directory to run Qdrant embedded instead of via Docker.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama server URL. Without it, retrieval degrades to sparse-only.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Embedding model. Changing it requires a full reindex.

environmentVariables.name: RAWTHINK_TOOL_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Which tools to expose: recall (4, read-only), record (5, the write path), or full (17).

environmentVariables.name: RAWTHINK_BM25_STATE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the BM25 state file. Defaults to <vault>/.bm25_state.json.

environmentVariables.name: RAWTHINK_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level for diagnostics on stderr.
